method: Read-only independent source and saved-output inspection; no compilation rerun, sampling or artifact/model modification except this review. Numeric budget arithmetic and compilation artifact hashes verified.
verdict: Accept limited zero-iteration compilation evidence and ordinary propositions; resource proposal is bounded but explicitly not dispatch-ready.

compilation.assessment: Source uses n.adapt=0, checks m$iter()==0, and captures sampler assignments for complete items, complete canonical score and masked/empty score fixtures. No updates or coda sampling calls. Same JAGS backend.
compilation.limits: Compilation of tiny fixtures does not establish full-data initial mapping, running target values in JAGS, posterior convergence or performance. subprocess timeout alone is not the reviewed multi-process resource dispatcher required for future sampling.

resource_proposal.findings: Caps reconcile arithmetically. A0 and A8 are alternatives, B separately approved. Requested failures retained. No recycling budget or optional extension. Measured historical A cost is separated from unmeasured score cost and extrapolated larger-case cost. Same-backend limitation is explicit.
resource_proposal.not_ready: Pinned executable commands, full initial mappings/reuse hashes and independently validated dispatcher enforcement remain gates. No approval or dispatch inferred.
resource_proposal.minor_editorial_issue: Plan top-level status and implementation_readiness predate completed tiny compilation and should be timestamp-scoped or reconciled to avoid implying no compilation anywhere.

ordinary_proofs.assessment: Derivative, coercivity and negative-Hessian-determinant arguments are valid under stated fixed-calibration, Gaussian-block and centered-coordinate assumptions. C2 two residual normalizers contribute a*v on affine zero-residual slice. C5 genetic variance contributes a^2*exp(-v)/2; remaining moderator-one zero genetic effects supply only linear terms. Item curvature bounds make determinants negative at finite states.
ordinary_proofs.limits: The symbolic fixtures check algebra, not source model independently. Neither conditional MAP uniqueness nor centered augmented-posterior nonconcavity establishes marginal hyperparameter likelihood uniqueness/multimodality or non-Gaussian observed-response identification. These exact targets stay pending.
